text:
Ezra: Notice: ap-southeast1 has ~110 GPU pods Pending after the midnight scheduler rollout. Many stuck on prebind/taint handshake.
Watcher-Bot: alert: gpu-prod/ap-southeast1 pending_pods=112 severity=warn dash=https://console/alerts/1815000000
Priya: Confirmed. Logs show repeated lines like 'prebind: waiting for taint-propagation' and kubelet attach queues hitting limits.
Marco: We rolled prebind-window -> 9s to reduce latebinds. In APAC that seems to amplify taint wait.
Ezra: Ops-SRE, can we toggle a region watchdog to disable aggressive prebind for ap-southeast1 while we triage?
Ops-SRE: Starting targeted feature-flag disable for ap-southeast1 (canary nodes first). Will report in 3m.
Marco: Short mitigation: bump kubelet nvattach-concurrency 3->10 in the region for reduced mount timeouts. Canary that after the flag.
Ops-SRE: Canary flag off applied at 1815000025. Pending dropped ~112 -> 48 in 70s.
Priya: After attach-concurrency canary (10% nodes) pending down to ~16 and eviction churn stopped. Good stopgap.
Ezra: Follow-ups: 1) implement a prebind-watchdog that cancels prebind if taint-prop p95 > X for region, 2) add region-aware rollout gating in deploys, 3) include quick runbook toggle for prebind per-region.
Marco: Also include cost calc for idle GPU-minutes in the postmortem. I'll sketch RFC: https://go/repo/rfcs/prebind-watchdog (WIP).
Watcher-Bot: incident: mitigated at 1815000048. Continue monitoring for 30m.
Ops-SRE: Closing canary thread; reopen if pending >50 for 10m. :thumbsup:
